activity.notes: Retry manifest after the v1 request was blocked because it attempted to create a duplicate polity canonical name for the already-existing 카잔 칸국. This version explicitly reuses the existing 'Khanate of Kazan' polity. Tatarica treats the first reign as probable in 1484-1485, so both endpoints remain approximate.

sources.title: Казанское ханство — TATARICA
sources.citation_text: Tatarica lists Muhammad Amin's separate Kazan reigns and describes the 1484-1485 first reign as reconstructed, the 1487-1495 second reign, and the 1502-1518 third reign.

sources.title: Мухаммад-Амин — TATARICA
sources.citation_text: Tatarica documents Muhammad Amin's 1487-1495 and 1502-1518 reigns, including his restoration in 1502 and death in 1518.
